description: This file defines the BookmarkField class used for creating bookmark objects within the MigraDoc document object model. It includes properties and methods for managing bookmark names, serialization, cloning, and internal values.

classes.name: BookmarkField
classes.description: Represents a bookmark in a document, used as a target for hyperlinks or page references.

classes.name: BookmarkField.BookmarkFieldValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable values for the BookmarkField properties, specifically the bookmark name.

methods.name: BookmarkField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new BookmarkField instance.

methods.name: BookmarkField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new BookmarkField with a specified parent DocumentObject.

methods.name: BookmarkField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new BookmarkField with a specified name.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the BookmarkField instance.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the BookmarkField into DDL format using the provided serializer.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Indicates whether the BookmarkField instance is null (not set).
